decision_text_verbatim:
3. GATE 15 — OWNER EXCEPTION FOR 9.1.0 ONLY

For 9.1.0 only, I accept an explicit release-policy exception for Gate #15.
The human comprehension requirement is not satisfied; Gate #15 remains
MANUAL_REVIEW and must not be represented as passed.

The human study is not authorized and must not be run, scheduled or
recruited. Disclose this exception verbatim in the release-policy record
and public release notes.

This exception applies to 9.1.0 only. It is not carried to any later release.
